instructions: Cut the top and bottom off the celery root, then cut away the thick skin with a sharp knife. Cut it into 3/4-inch cubes.
Dice the onion. Peel the carrots and cut them into thick half-moons. Cut the potatoes into 3/4-inch pieces. Mince 1/4 cup of the parsley and chop 2 tbsp of the dill.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4 minutes, until soft and shiny.
Add the celery root, carrots and potatoes with 1/2 tsp of the salt. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until the edges are lightly browned.
Add the paprika and stir for 20 seconds. Pour in the orange juice and 1/2 cup of water.
Cover and cook on medium-low for 15 minutes, until a fork slides into the celery root. Add a splash of water if the pot looks dry.
Take the pot off the heat. Squeeze in 1 tbsp lemon juice, then stir in the sugar, the parsley and the remaining 1/2 tsp salt.
Cut the rest of the lemon into wedges.
Taste it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt or a squeeze of lemon.
Transfer to a serving dish and top with the dill. Serve warm or at room temperature, with the lemon wedges.
method_notes: Cooking Gorgeous and Cinnamon Snail both braise celery root with onion, carrot and potato in olive oil, orange and lemon juice and a little sugar, and serve it at room temperature. Cinnamon Snail (the lead, 32 minutes) browns the vegetables briefly and adds the lemon and sugar after cooking; Cooking Gorgeous simmers about 30 minutes and takes longer to cut. This follows the faster one. Each page has only one or two ratings, so this is a fallback lead.
